title: THE PRAYER YOUR ENEMIES DON'T WANT YOU TO PRAY AT 3AM
text: Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Glory to God. Thank you, Lord Jesus. Thank you, Holy Spirit. We worship you tonight. We give you praise. We give you all the glory. There is none like you, Lord. There is none like you. Before we go into this word tonight, I want you to do something very quickly. Wherever you are watching from, share this broadcast [music] right now. Send the link to someone. Send it to your family WhatsApp group. >> [music] >> Send it to that friend who has been going through warfare. The Holy Spirit told me there are people who will stumble on this broadcast and their lives will never remain the same. >> [music] >> You might be the vessel God uses tonight to deliver someone from 20 years of bondage. So, share it now. Do not delay. Let the word go forth. Amen. Now, lift your hands wherever you are. I want you to begin to worship. Not religious worship. Not rehearsed worship. I want the kind of worship [music] that comes from a place of desperation. The kind that David offered when he danced with everything he had before the ark. The kind that causes angels to stand at attention. The kind that makes hell tremble. You are Yahweh. You are Yahweh. There is no one beside you. You are Yahweh. We magnify you tonight. We exalt your name. Every other name bows. Every throne crumbles. Every kingdom shakes. >> [music] >> But your throne, oh God, is established forever. Hallelujah. Thank you, Jesus. Thank you, Lord. I can sense the presence of the Holy Spirit so strongly right now. Something is about to shift. Something is about to break. Before I even begin to preach, the atmosphere is already charged. I feel it. You should feel it, too. If you are sensitive in your spirit, you know that this is not an ordinary broadcast. [music] This is a divine appointment. God set this time for you. God orchestrated the events that brought you here tonight. Nothing about this moment is accidental. >> [music] >> Glory to God. Let me talk to you. Open your Bible to the book of Psalm 91:1-6 and then hold your Bible there because we're also going to look at Isaiah 54:17. These are anchor scriptures tonight, but the Holy Spirit is going to take us through many passages as the spirit leads. Psalm 91:1-6 says, "He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. >> [music] >> I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in him will I trust. Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler and from the noisome pestilence. He shall cover thee with his feathers and under his wings shall thou trust. His truth shall be thy shield and buckler. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flieth by day, nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasted at noonday." Did you catch that? Thou shalt not be afraid for the [music] terror by night, the terror by night. That phrase alone should tell you that there are activities that take place in the night season that are designed to terrorize the children of God. There are arrows that are launched under the cover of darkness. There are meetings that are held at midnight where your name is mentioned, >> [music] >> where your destiny is discussed, where evil verdicts are passed, and the reason the enemy operates at night is because he is a coward. He does not want to fight you when you are alert. >> [music] >> He does not want to confront you when you are standing in the full armor of God, but he waits for the moment you are asleep. >> [music] >> He waits for the moment your guard is down. He waits for 2:00 a.m., 3:00 a.m. when the world is silent, when you are deep in sleep, [music] when your consciousness is switched off, that is when he moves. Listen carefully. I'm not teaching you theory tonight. [music] I am giving you revelation that has the capacity [singing] to permanently alter the trajectory of your life. There are people [music] listening to me right now and you have wondered why your life has been on a cycle. Every year, the same pattern. Every January, promises. By March, confusion. By June, setback. By December, you are exactly where you started and you keep asking God, "What is happening? Why does breakthrough keep slipping through my fingers? Why do doors open and close before I can walk through them?" >> [music] >> Let me tell you what is happening. There are altars and those altars are active and those altars are speaking. They are speaking against your progress. They are speaking against your health. They are speaking against your marriage. They are speaking against your finances. They are speaking against your children. And the reason you have not been able to break free is because you have been fighting in the daytime what was programmed in the night. You have been trying to solve with logic what was manufactured in the spirit realm. You cannot cancel a spiritual transaction with a physical strategy. It does not work. That is why God brought you here tonight. He brought you here because it is time for the cycle to end. It is time for the embargo to be dismantled. It is time for the verdict of darkness to be overturned by [music] the verdict of heaven. And I decree right now, in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, every altar that has kept your life in a loop, I command that altar to catch fire. You see, the enemy has a specific agenda when it comes to the 3:00 a.m. hour. In scripture, the third watch of the night, from midnight to the third hour, was known to be a period of heightened spiritual activity. It was at midnight that the death angel passed through Egypt. It was at midnight that Paul and Silas prayed and the prison shook. It was in the deep watches of the night that [music] Jacob wrestled with the angel and would not let go until his blessing came. There is something about the night season. There are transactions that take place [music] there. Now, the enemy knows this. The kingdom of darkness understands spiritual timing [music] better than many Christians do and that is a tragedy. While you are asleep, there are covens that are awake. While you are scrolling your phone at midnight and drifting off to sleep, there are agents [music] of darkness that are seated in circles calling your name, invoking your image, and passing sentences over your destiny. This is not fiction. This is not exaggeration. Ephesians 6:12 tells us, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against [music] powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." Spiritual wickedness in high places. High places, these are organized systems, hierarchies of darkness. [music] They have structure, they have assignment, they have timing, and one of their most effective operational windows is the 3:00 a.m. hour. There is a prayer your enemies [music] do not want you to pray. And the reason they do not want you to pray it is because the moment you pray it, [music] chains begin to break. The moment you pray it, verdicts begin to be reversed. The moment you pray it, heaven responds with fire [music] and every demonic structure that has been erected over your life begins to crumble. Thus saith the spirit of God, "The season of silence is over. The season where you were bound while your enemies operated freely is coming to an end tonight." I prophesy over your life from this moment forward, you will not sleep through your deliverance. You will not be unconscious while your destiny is being tampered with. The spirit of God is going to wake you up. The spirit of God is going to stir your spirit. >> [music] >> The spirit of God is going to put a prayer in your mouth that the gates of hell cannot withstand. Let me go deeper. Turn with me to Genesis 31:29. Laban spoke to Jacob and said, "It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt, but the God of your father spoke unto me yesterday night saying, 'Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.'" This is powerful. [music] Laban had the intention. Laban had the resources. Laban had the evil desire. He wanted to harm Jacob, but God showed up in the night and shut Laban's mouth. God intercepted the plan before it could be executed. This is what the prayer of [music] 3:00 a.m. does. [singing] It does not wait for the enemy to attack. It intercepts. It disrupts. It arrests. [music] Before the arrow is released, the prayer has already built a wall of fire around you. >> [music] >> This is what I call preemptive spiritual warfare. You do not wait for the sickness to manifest before you pray. You do not wait for the contract to fall through before you intercede. You do not wait for the marriage to collapse before you cry out. You move first. You strike [music] first. You pray first. And when you pray in the 3:00 a.m. hour, when the enemy expected you to be sleeping, when the enemy expected to find you vulnerable, instead he finds you armed. He finds you dangerous. He finds you covered in the fire of the Holy Ghost. >> [music] >> Someone needs to hear this. The prayer your enemies do not want you to pray >> [music] >> is not a casual prayer. It is not a religious prayer. It is not the kind of prayer where you say, "God [music] bless me." and go back to sleep. No. It is the kind of prayer that makes you a terror to the kingdom of darkness. >> [music] >> It is the kind of prayer that causes principalities to relocate. It is the kind of prayer that opens prison doors at midnight like it did for Paul and Silas. It is the kind of prayer that brings angels into your situation. It is the [music] kind of prayer that reverses 20 years of delay in one night. Now, let me show you from 2 Kings chapter 19 verse 35. It says, "And it came to pass that night that the angel of the Lord went out and smote in the camp of the Assyrians and 104 score and 5,000. And when they arose early in the morning, behold, >> [music] >> they were all dead corpses." 185,000 soldiers destroyed [music] in one night. Not by swords, not by armies, by one angel, one. And it happened at night. While Sennacherib thought he was going to overrun Jerusalem, while the enemy thought victory was [music] certain, God moved in the darkness. God moved when no one was watching. God released one angel and the [music] entire army was annihilated. This is what God wants to do with your enemies tonight. Not your human enemies. We do not fight people. But the spiritual forces behind the attacks on your [music] life, the demonic agents assigned to frustrate your progress, the ancestral powers that have held your family lineage in bondage for generations, God wants to send his angel tonight. And by morning, every adversary will be a dead corpse. Every opposition will be neutralized. Every barrier will be demolished. I decree [music] and declare over your life, what Sennacherib could not do to Hezekiah, your enemies will not do to you. What Pharaoh could not do to Moses, your enemies will not do to you. >> [music] >> What Haman could not do to Mordecai, your enemies will not do to you. What the lions could not do to Daniel, your enemies will not do to you. What the furnace could not do to the three Hebrew boys, your enemies will not do to you. You are protected, you are covered, you are shielded, you are guarded by the host of heaven. There are dimensions to this that the average believer does not understand. The 3:00 a.m. prayer is not about the time on your clock. >> [music] >> It is about a posture. It is about a level of spiritual intensity that says I will not be defeated, [music] I will not be silenced, I will not be pushed out of my inheritance. It is about rising when everything in your flesh says sleep. It is about opening your mouth when everything in the natural says there is no point. It is about pressing into the presence of God when the enemy has done everything [music] to make you feel like God is not listening. Let me tell you something from the spirit. The reason the enemy fights your prayer life more than anything [music] else is because prayer is the one weapon that gives you access to unlimited power. Your education is good, but it has limits. Your connections are valuable, but they can fail you. Your money can open doors, but there are doors that money cannot touch. But prayer, prayer has no ceiling. Prayer has no boundary. [music] Prayer connects you to the throne of the universe. Prayer brings the creator of heaven and earth into your situation. >> [music] >> And when God shows up, it does not matter who is against you. Romans 8:31 says, "If God be [music] for us, who can be against us?" I feel the fire of the Holy Ghost right now. Something is happening in the spirit. [music] I can feel chains breaking. I can feel strongholds crumbling. There is somebody watching right now, and for the past 7 years you have been under a financial embargo. Money comes in and disappears. Opportunities arise and vanish. You work harder than anyone around you, but you have nothing to show for it. Listen to me. Thus saith the Lord, the embargo is broken tonight. The spirit [music] of poverty that was assigned to your bloodline, I command it to release you now in the name of Jesus. The devourer that has been eating your harvest, the Lord rebukes him tonight on your account. Malachi 3:11 is activated over your finances, and I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruit of your ground. I need you to receive that. Open your hands right now. Open your hands as a symbol of receiving. Father, I thank you for this financial turnaround. I thank you for opening doors that have been shut. >> [music] >> I thank you for releasing resources. I thank you for connecting my son, my daughter to their helpers of destiny in the name of Jesus. Now, let me go into the prayer. >> [music] >> This is where we shift. This is where the atmosphere changes. This is where we move from teaching to traveling. I need you to stand on your feet wherever you are. Whether you are in your bedroom, in your car, in your office, stand up. If you cannot stand, lift your hands. This is not a moment to be casual. The prayers we're about to pray are the prayers that your enemies have been afraid of. These are the prayers that they have worked so hard to keep [music] you from praying. They have used tiredness to stop you. They have used depression to silence you. >> [music] >> They have used confusion to scatter your focus. They have used offense to disconnect you from prayer altars. But tonight, by the mercies of the living God, you are here. And because you are here, everything changes. >> [music] >> Father, in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I come before your throne tonight. I come not on the basis of my righteousness, but on the basis of the finished work of Calvary. I [music] come under the covering of the blood of Jesus. I come with boldness because your word says in Hebrews 4:16 that I can come boldly onto the throne of grace to obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need. [music] And Lord, this is a time of need. Your people need you. They need your power. They need your intervention. They need your fire. I take authority tonight over every altar that was raised in the night season against anyone under the sound of my voice. Every evil altar erected in covens, in shrines, in forest, in waters, at crossroads, under trees, [music] in graveyards, I command every such altar to catch fire right now in the name of Jesus. Every incantation spoken at 3:00 a.m. over your destiny, I reverse it by the blood of Jesus. Every ritual [music] performed at midnight to cage your star, to bury your glory, to silence your voice, I dismantle it by the thunder of God. [music] Every evil priest servicing an altar against your marriage, against your womb, against your [music] health, against your business, I decree that the hand of that priest withers right now. The way the hand of Jeroboam dried up at the altar, every hand raised against you in witchcraft, let it wither now in Jesus' name. Pray with me. Open your mouth [music] and pray. Do not whisper. This is not the time for gentle prayers. This is war. Your destiny is at stake. Your children's future is at stake. [music] Open your mouth and pray. Every covenant that was made on my behalf without my consent, >> [music] >> every covenant made through my bloodline, every covenant activated through what I ate in the dream, through what was done to me in the night, every [music] evil covenant, I renounce you tonight. I break you tonight. I dissolve you tonight by the blood of the lamb. I am no longer bound by what my fathers agreed to. I am no longer held by what my mothers participated in. The blood of Jesus has set me free. Galatians 3:13 says, "Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us. For it is written, cursed is everyone that hangeth on a tree. I declare that every curse pronounced over your life at midnight, every curse released through envious tongues, every curse activated through evil prayers, every curse empowered by ancestral altars, >> [music] >> I break them all tonight. By the authority vested in me as a son of God, by the power of the name above every name, I break every curse, I nullify every curse, I cancel every curse. They shall not stand. They shall not prosper. Isaiah 54:17 says, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn." >> [music] >> I condemn every tongue, every tongue that has spoken death over your life, I condemn it. Every tongue that has spoken barrenness over your womb, I condemn it. Every tongue that has spoken failure over your career, I [music] condemn it. Every tongue that has spoken delay over your marriage, I condemn it. Every tongue that has spoken sickness over your body, I condemn it. You will not die, but live and [music] declare the works of the Lord. Psalm 118:17. Now, listen to me. There are specific areas we need to target tonight [music] because the enemy does not fight you generally, he fights you specifically. He has specific agents assigned to specific areas of your life. So, we are going to pray specifically >> [music] >> destiny restoration. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray for everyone under the sound of my voice whose destiny has been tampered with. There are [music] people here tonight whose stars were taken away in the dream. There are people here tonight whose glory was exchanged in the spirit realm. [music] There are people here tonight who should have been far ahead in life, but something happened in the night that kept them stagnant. I speak to every stolen destiny. I command restoration right now. Every virtue that was taken from you in the dream, I command it to return sevenfold. Job 42:10 says, "And the Lord turned the captivity of Job when he prayed for his friends. Also, the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before." I decree double [music] restoration over your life. What the cankerworm has eaten, what [music] the palmerworm has eaten, what the caterpillar has eaten, what the locust has eaten, Joel 2:25 is activated. "I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten." [music] Every destiny hijacker, I command you to release your hold right now. Let go in Jesus' name. The destiny of this man, the destiny of this woman, the destiny of this young person is not your property. It belongs to God. It was designed by God. It was ordained by God, and no power [music] of darkness has the authority to rewrite what God has written. Jeremiah 29:11 says, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, said the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you an expected [music] end." I declare your expected end is restored. What God planned for you before the foundation of the world is now reinstated. [music] The detour is over. The delay is canceled. The confusion is cleared. You are getting back on track. You are getting back on course. Your destiny is realigning right now as I speak. Someone hearing my voice, the Lord is showing me that your gift has been suppressed. [music] There is a talent, an ability, a calling that you have not been able to function in. Every time you try, [music] something blocks you. Every time you step forward, something pushes you back. >> [music] >> I break that suppression tonight. I break it by fire. I command your gift to come alive. [music] I command your calling to be activated. I command your anointing to be released without restriction, without limitation, without hindrance in the mighty name of Jesus. Family deliverance >> [music] >> Now we move to the family. This is critical because many of the battles people fight are not personal battles. [music] They are family battles. They are bloodline battles. There are curses that travel through generations. There are patterns that repeat in families. Every firstborn in this family struggles financially. Every woman in this family has marital problems. Every man in this family dies before 60. >> [music] >> These are not coincidences. These are covenants. These are altars. These are spiritual realities that must be confronted. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come against every generational curse operating in the families represented here tonight. Every curse of premature death, I break it. Every curse of madness, I break it. Every curse of poverty, I break it. >> [music] >> Every curse of divorce, I break it. Every curse of barrenness, I break it. Every curse of [music] addiction, I break it. Every curse of failure at the edge of breakthrough, I break it. I speak to the bloodline. I speak to the root. Whatever was planted in your family tree by the enemy, I command it to be uprooted by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Matthew 15:13 says, "Every plant which my heavenly Father had not planted shall be rooted up." I root up every evil plantation in your family. Every evil tree that has been producing bitter fruit in your lineage, I cut it down tonight. I release deliverance upon your father. I release deliverance upon your mother. I release deliverance upon your siblings. I release deliverance upon your children. I release deliverance upon your spouse. Let the fire of God go through your family like it went through the camp of the Assyrians. Let every Sennacherib assigned against your household be destroyed tonight. Someone under the sound of my voice, your mother has been sick for a long time. The doctors have not found a solution. I speak the [music] healing power of God into her body right now. That affliction is not unto death. She will live. She will recover. She will testify. The same God who healed the woman with the issue of blood for 12 years is healing your mother tonight. And there is someone, your brother has been in bondage to a substance, alcohol, drugs, something has a grip on his life. I break that grip tonight. I release the fire of deliverance. That addiction [music] is broken. That chain is severed. Freedom is flowing into his life right now in Jesus' name. Marriage breakthrough. Lift [music] your hands. If you are believing God for a marriage breakthrough, whether you are single and believing for a godly [music] partner, or you are married and your marriage is under attack, lift your hands and receive. Father, I pray for every single person under the sound of my voice who desires [music] a godly marriage, I speak to their destiny helpers. Wherever you are, I command you to locate them. >> [music] >> I break every spirit of rejection that has kept potential partners away. I break every spirit of delay that has prolonged their season of waiting. I break every spiritual husband and spiritual wife that has been [music] blocking their marital destiny. For those who are married, I pray for peace. I pray for unity. I pray for restoration. Every third party influence, whether human or demonic, I command it to be removed from your marriage tonight. >> [music] >> Every spirit of misunderstanding, every spirit of anger, every spirit of unforgiveness, every spirit of lust, every spirit of infidelity, I bind them all and cast them out in the name of Jesus. Proverbs 18:22 says, "Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing and obtaineth favor of the Lord." I decree that favor is being released into your marital life tonight. The same God who brought Eve to [music] Adam knows your address. He knows your name. He knows your situation and he's arranging things in your favor right now. >> [music] >> Someone hearing my voice, the Lord is saying to me, "Tell that woman, tell that man, this year will not end without a ring on your finger." The embargo on your marital destiny is broken. The one that God has prepared [music] for you is already being drawn towards you. Do not give up. Do not settle. Do not compromise. [music] What God has for you is on the way. And for those whose marriages are in crisis, whose homes are on the verge of collapse, I speak the peace of God. I speak restoration. I speak reconciliation. What the enemy meant for evil, God is [music] turning it around for your good. Your marriage will not end in divorce. Your marriage will not end in shame. Your marriage will be a testimony. [music] It will be a beacon of light. It will glorify God. Financial gates opening. >> [music] >> Now, let me address this area because I know there are many people who are struggling financially. The economy is hard. Jobs are [music] scarce. Businesses are failing and on top of that there are spiritual [music] forces that are working against your financial advancement. Listen carefully. Poverty is not just an economic condition. In many cases, it is a spiritual condition. There are people who are qualified, hard working, diligent, but they remain poor because there is an altar somewhere that is swallowing their prosperity. >> [music] >> Haggai 1:6 describes this condition. Ye have sown much and bringing little. Ye eat, but ye have not enough. Ye drink, [music] but ye are not filled with drink. Ye clothe you, but there is none warm. And he that earneth wages [music] earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes. A bag with holes. Does that sound like your financial life? >> [music] >> You earn, but it disappears. You receive, but it evaporates. You plan, but it scatters. That [music] is not natural. That is a spiritual condition. There is a devourer. There is a leaking spirit. [music] There is a curse operating against your finances. But I have good news. Tonight, [music] the devourer is being rebuked. Tonight, the holes in your bag are being sealed. Tonight, God is opening a new financial gate for you. >> [music] >> Father, in the name of Jesus, I decree financial liberation. I decree [music] financial breakthrough. I decree financial increase. I decree that [music and singing] the gates of prosperity that have been shut against your people are flung open tonight. Deuteronomy 28:12 says, "The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand. And thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow." I decree you are moving from borrower to lender. I decree you are moving from lack to abundance. I decree you are moving from survival to surplus. The treasures that have been locked away from you are being released tonight. Hidden streams of income are being opened. Unexpected doors of financial favor are swinging wide open. Every witchcraft operation that is manipulating your finances, I destroy it by fire. >> [music] >> Every evil hand that reaches into your account, into your business, into your salary before you receive it, I cut off that in the name of Jesus. Every satanic accountant [music] that has been auditing your blessings and siphoning your resources, I terminate your assignment tonight. Someone under the sound of my voice, the Lord is showing me a business that has been stagnant for 3 years. No customers, >> [music] >> no growth, no progress. I speak to that business right now. I command the spirit of stagnation to come out. I release the anointing for increase. I release the anointing for multiplication. Customers [music] are coming, contracts are coming, favor is coming. >> [music] >> Your business will flourish. Your business will expand. Before the end of this season, you will testify of what God has done. And there is someone who has been applying for jobs and receiving rejection after rejection. I break [music] the spirit of rejection over your career right now. The next application you send will bring a response. >> [music] >> The next interview you attend will bring an offer, and it will not just be any job. It will be the job that God has prepared for you. It will come with favor, it will come with promotion, [music] it will come with divine acceleration. I decree that Psalm 23:5 is manifesting in your financial life. Thou preparest [music] a table before [singing] me in the presence of my enemies. Thou anointest my head with oil. My cup runneth over. Your cup is running over. Your season of overflow has begun. Health and healing. There is somebody watching me right now and you are battling with a health condition. Maybe the doctors have given you a report that is not favorable. Maybe you have been managing a condition that medication has not been able to resolve. Maybe there is pain in your body right now as I speak. Listen to me. Exodus 15:26 says, "I am the Lord that healed thee." Jehovah Rapha, the God who heals, not the God who used to heal, not the God who might heal if he feels like it. The God who heals, present tense, active, available, willing. Isaiah 53:5 [music] says, "But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities. The chastisement of our peace was upon him, and with his stripes we are healed, we are healed." [music] Not we will be healed someday, we are healed. It is a finished work. Jesus already paid for your healing on the cross. The stripes he bore in his back were your receipt. [music] Your healing has already been purchased. All that is needed is for you to receive it by faith. >> [music] >> So, right now, I want you to place your hand on whatever part of your body that is afflicted. Place your hand there and receive. I am going to pray, and the healing power of God is going to flow. >> [music] >> In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I speak to every infirmity in the bodies of those under the sound of my voice. I command healing to flow from the crown of your head to the sole of your feet. [music] Let the healing virtue of the resurrected Christ saturate every cell, every tissue, every organ, every bone, every nerve, every vein. Cancer, I command you to die. Diabetes, I command your assignment to end. High [music] blood pressure, I speak normalcy. Heart conditions, I speak restoration. Kidney problems, I speak healing. Fibroid, I command you to dissolve. Tumors, I command you to shrink and disappear. Migraine, I command you to cease. Back pain, I command you to leave. >> [music] >> Arthritis, I command you to lose your grip. Every affliction with a name, and every affliction without a name, I command you to bow to the name of Jesus. The woman with the issue of blood spent [music] 12 years and all her money on doctors, but the moment she touched the hem of his garment, [music] virtue flowed and she was made whole. I release that same virtue into your body tonight. Be healed, be made whole, be restored. Someone hearing my voice, you have been having constant headaches that no medication resolves. The Lord is showing me that this is not a medical condition. It is a spiritual attack. >> [music] >> Arrows fired at your head in the night, I pull out every arrow right now. I pull it out by the blood of Jesus and I release healing. Headaches will stop, they will stop tonight. You will sleep in peace and wake up in strength. And there is someone whose eyesight has been deteriorating. I speak to your eyes. I command clarity, I command restoration, I command the eyes that God [music] gave you to function at their full capacity. Receive your sight in the name of Jesus. >> [music] >> There is a man watching and you have been having chest pains. Fear has gripped your heart because you are afraid it might be something serious. I speak [music] peace to your heart. I speak strength to your cardiovascular system. No weapon formed against your health shall prosper. You will live and not die. Your days are not over. Your assignment is not complete. There is still work for you to do and God will preserve you to do it. Breaking covenants, [music] curses and evil altars. Now we enter deeper waters. Pay attention because this section is critical. Many people are living under the weight of covenants they never made, curses they never spoke and altars they never built. These things were done by parents, [music] grandparents, ancestors, people who lived before you were born. But because [music] you carried their blood, you also carry the consequences of their actions. In [music] Africa and many parts of the world, our forefathers made covenants with deities. They sacrificed to idols. They entered pacts with marine spirits, with queen of the coast, with territorial spirits. They gave offerings to river gods, to mountain spirits, to ancestral altars, and these covenants were not just for one generation. They were perpetual covenants.
